samples.name: SideContentPosition
samples.title: Side Content Position
samples.description: The side content can be placed at the "Start" or at the "End" via the `sideContentPosition` property.

samples.name: EqualSplit
samples.title: Equal Split
samples.description: When `equalSplit` property is set, the main and side contents take equal space.

samples.name: LayoutsConfiguration
samples.title: Layouts Configuration
samples.description: The FlexibleColumnLayout supports customization of the column sizes within the limits of the current layout.

samples.name: CustomTitle
samples.title: Custom Title
samples.description: By default the IllustratedMessage displays built-in title, but a custom title can be also set.

samples.name: WithDialog
samples.title: IllustratedMessage in Dialog
samples.description: In general IllustratedMessage can be displayed in many places and cases - one of them is inside Dialog.

samples.name: Vertical
samples.title: Vertical Layout
samples.description: The thumbnails and selected item are vertically placed. To enable this layout - set `layout="Vertical"`.

samples.name: Horizontal
samples.title: Horizontal Layout
samples.description: The thumbnails and selected item are horizontally placed. To enable this layout - set `layout="Horizontal"`. You can also define on which side of the selected item to place the thumbnails.

samples.name: ThumbnailCustom
samples.title: Custom Thumbnail
samples.description: By default the image passed to the MediaGalleryItem is reused as a thumbnail. You can display another image as thumbnail via the `thumbnail` slot of the `MediaGalleryItem`.

samples.name: WithSelectedItem
samples.title: Selected Item
samples.description: You can predefine the selected item.

samples.name: WithDisabledItem
samples.title: Disabled Item
samples.description: The MediaGallery can show disabled items as well.

samples.name: Interactive
samples.title: Interactive Display Area
samples.description: Setting `interactiveDisplayArea` property makes the display area interactive, e.g. clickable.

samples.name: InShellBar
samples.title: Notifications in ShellBar
samples.description: The main usage of the Notifications is in the ShellBar. Press the "notifications" icon on the right side of the ShellBar to show the Notifications.

samples.name: WithShellBar
samples.title: ProductSwitch in ShellBar
samples.description: Press the "grid" on the right-most part of the ShellBar to show the ProductSwitch.

samples.name: Basic
samples.title: Basic Sample
samples.description: A Search component with enabled scope and items and filtering by scope.

samples.name: Advanced
samples.title: Filtering
samples.description: The examples show the search message area, the search action, filtering per user input, typeahead and highlighting suggestions per user input.

samples.name: AdvancedFilter
samples.title: Advanced Filtering Button
samples.description: This example shows how to use a custom advanced filtering button via the `filterButton` slot.

samples.name: Byline
samples.title: Byline items
samples.description: The example shows how to display byline items with an image and description.

samples.name: ShowMore
samples.title: Show More Item
samples.description: This example shows how to use a Show More Item.

samples.name: Actions
samples.title: Actions
samples.description: This example shows how to use interactive elements in search items.

samples.name: Loading
samples.title: Loading State
samples.description: This example shows the loading indicator during async search operations.

samples.name: Basic
samples.title: Basic Sample
samples.description: The ShellBar includes Back button, Logo, Title and Profile image.

samples.name: Advanced
samples.title: All Features
samples.description: A comprehensive ShellBar demonstrating all available features including notifications, search, content items, and profile.

samples.name: EmbeddedBackNavigation
samples.title: Embedded Back Navigation
samples.description: ShellBar with embedded back navigation button in the start area.

samples.name: TrialExample
samples.title: Trial Example
samples.description: ShellBar configured for trial environments with trial tags and remaining days indicator.

samples.name: MultipleProductiveInstances
samples.title: Multiple Productive Instances
samples.description: ShellBar setup for multiple productive system instances with region indicators.

samples.name: MultipleNonProductiveInstances
samples.title: Multiple Non-Productive Instances
samples.description: ShellBar setup for multiple non-productive system instances with system and region tags.

samples.name: Overflow
samples.title: Application-Level Overflow
samples.description: This sample demonstrates how applications can implement custom overflow handling for content items.

samples.name: UnselectableParentItems
samples.title: Unselectable Parent Items
samples.description: When a parent item is selected, it will expand or collapse the list of child items, instead of the parent being selected itself.

samples.name: QuickAction
samples.title: Quick Action
samples.description: Quick action items allow for providing access to frequent functionality.

samples.name: OverlayMode
samples.title: Overlay Mode
samples.description: SideNavigation is enabled to be used inside a responsive popover. This example shows how to achieve overlay mode with correct design and interaction.

samples.name: CustomWidth
samples.title: Defining Custom Width
samples.description: The width of the side navigation panel can be customized using CSS. The panel must be at least 16 rem wide to maintain readability and layout stability.

samples.name: Tags
samples.title: Indication Tags
samples.description: Navigation items can display indication tags to highlight status or phases such as "New", "Beta", or "Deprecated".

samples.name: WithHeader
samples.title: Timeline with Header and Info Bar

samples.name: SaveMode
samples.title: Save Mode
samples.description: By default the dialog shows a single **Close** button and follows an implicit-save flow. Setting `saveMode` replaces the footer with **Save** and **Cancel** buttons.

samples.name: CustomTabs
samples.title: Custom Tabs
samples.description: The ViewSettingsDialog supports custom tabs alongside the built-in Sort, Filter, and Group tabs.

samples.name: Basic

samples.name: PageMode
